title: Phishing emails
leadParagraph: Zscaler has reported a phishing campaign that is abusing Appspot.com and Web.app; both legitimate domains associated with Google Cloud. The campaign deploys well-executed landing pages that spoof the two widely used sites. TTCSIRT strongly encourages administrators to review the following report from Zscaler and blacklist the listed domains and URLs:
